# muxt fmt cannot read a stylesheet linked from another host, so the
# author CSS is unknown and every element of the partial is left as
# written.

muxt generate --input-static-assets-directory=assets --output-static-assets-path=/static --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt fmt -w partial.gohtml
cmp partial.gohtml partial.orig

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.24
-- templates.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index() string { return "" }
-- assets/style.css --
.code{white-space:pre}
-- layout.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.example/site.css">{{template "partial"}}{{end}}

<div class="code">
  keep   me
</div>
<p>x</p>
</section>{{end}}
